answer: A basalt foundation no farm can fake: every epoch, a random tenth of established identities must re-prove with a task drawn from their own settled-answer history — the prompt hashes their past verdicts, so a clone with no history has nothing to hash and must first earn it by real work. Each re-proof costs 6 hours of attested grading checked by three random peers; failing or skipping it de-establishes the identity. An orchard of 1,000 puppets faces 100 re-proofs per epoch, each unique to one puppet's history, none shareable, none precomputable — the shale under the farm is its own empty past.
